Balloons are one of the leading non-food causes of choking in children.

A blueberry is firm, so the force of a back blow can shift it and pop it out. A piece of popped balloon is soft and thin. It moulds to the shape of the airway and seals it like cling wrap, and a back blow has almost nothing to grip onto.

At your next party, adults blow up the balloons, every popped piece gets picked up straight away, and foil balloons are the safer pick for the under fives 🎈

Our course covers the hazards most parents never think about, and exactly what to do if one gets past you 💜
